proof_body:
by
  intro a b c t s hts
  have hcongr : (∫ x in t..s, |(a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) - ((a * t ^ 2 + b * t + c) + (2 * a * t + b) * (x - t))|) = ∫ x in t..s, |a| * (x - t) ^ 2 := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x _ => ?_
    rw [show (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) - ((a * t ^ 2 + b * t + c) + (2 * a * t + b) * (x - t)) = a * (x - t) ^ 2 by ring, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (x - t))]
  have hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc t s, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (x - t) ^ 3 / 3) ((x - t) ^ 2) x := by
    intro x _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x - t) 1 x := (hasDerivAt_id' x).sub_const t
    exact ((h1.fun_pow 3).div_const 3).congr_deriv (by norm_num)
  rw [hcongr, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hd ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : ℝ => (x - t) ^ 2).intervalIntegrable t s)]
  ring
